notes.title: TimeTekker is becoming a free game!
notes.notes:
In celebration of the 3rd anniversary of our previous game release, we are making our current Steam titles completely free to own!

Starting 8/25/2021, [b][i]TimeTekker[/i][/b] and [b][i]AstroViking[/i][/b] will be made free, permanently!

We sincerely thank everyone who has purchased or played our releases over the past few years. Though we love these games, they have remained obscure over their lifetime, and we really want people to enjoy them! We think that removing the barrier to entry at this point in their lifecycle will enable more people to try them out, and hopefully have fun with them.

We also have an unannounced, but ambitious project in development that we've been keeping occupied with over the last few years. We hope to share it with you someday! In the meantime, we hope you enjoy these newly free games!

The roll out will take place over the course of today. You won't actually be able to obtain any of the new achievements until the game is updated. [b]When you see the game download an update today, then you'll be able to earn them![/b]

notes.title: TimeTekker's Sister Game is on Steam!
notes.notes:
Our next game is almost here! Developed alongside TimeTekker with a larger team, AstroViking is a similarly styled top down shooter with horde mode inspirations! Upgrade your Viking warrior with different skill paths and 60+ upgrades to choose from as you battle endlessly against waves of alien monsters!

The game will be bundled with TimeTekker at launch on Aug. 10th, so you can get it at a discount if you own TimeTekker already! It's $2.99 and will be launching at 15% off! 

Thank you all for playing our games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/903580/AstroViking/

notes.title: Updates so far
notes.notes:
This is a quick summary of the changes made to the game since launch, all in one place:

- Xbox controller support added and recently bugfixed
- Laser pointer effect added to improve accuracy with a controller
- Left handed control scheme for keyboard added
- Major resolution bugfixes for Mac
- Volume control slider added in the in-game settings
- Leaderboard connectivity services improved and bugfixed
- Slight difficulty rebalancing
- Out of bounds glitch fixed
- Various minor visual improvements

Also, the golden joystick award we won from the TERMINUS festival ːsteamhappyː:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32705764/267ee6a4880ce25c09c7e53e794f42e9a7c11ae3.jpg[/img]

Things are happening on our end with a follow up to this game, so keep your eyes peeled for our upcoming release!

notes.title: Controller Support Added!
notes.notes:
EDIT: The bugs have seemingly been worked out. I also added a laser pointer effect if you're using a controller which makes it easier to aim.

In response to some requests for controller support, TimeTekker now natively accepts Xbox controller input! It was a little difficult to get working, and the menu still requires mouse input, but the main game is totally working with a controller. 

The game will determine what style you want to play with via how you progress past the title screen. If you press A on an Xbox controller, it will load the game with Xbox button prompts and lock out keyboard input. If you click to get past the title screen, it'll load the game normally. Tutorials also show Xbox controller configs instead of the mouse and keyboard stuff if you choose to use a controller.

I don't own a PS4 controller so I can't say that non Xbox branded support will be coming any time soon, but please let me know if there is a demand for it. I might be able to figure it out in time. The Mac version also will not have these changes applied to it unless the community wants it. The Mac version is developed in a separate environment from the Windows and Linux ones, so any additional features will require some extra time to get done.

Please let me know if you find any bugs!

notes.title: Major Resolution Bugfix & Audio Options Added!
notes.notes:
Another quick patch! 

This one fixes a major issue with the game window showing some crazy glitchy visuals if you were playing on a non-standard or ultrawide resolution. Next time you boot the game, the resolution will automatically correct itself to look proper if you were affected by this issue. All OS versions of the game have been tested, so this should (hopefully) be the last resolution bugfix the game needs.

A volume slider has also been added so you don't need to use the volume mixer to change how loud the game is.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Left-handed control style added!
notes.notes: This is a minor change, but one that has been much requested. The game now allows you to use the arrow keys as a substitute for WASD, which is a control scheme that left-handed users have asked for. Lefties rejoice!
